'''Aeios''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Aeios worked for [[Alina Impeveri]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. When Impeveri was tried to find the crashed [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Skall Delos]], she wanted to put anyone else who was searching for him off the trail. So to this end she placed [[Mind trick/Legends|Force illusions]] on Aeios, the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Tot]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naren]] to make them all resemble Delos. The illusion masking Aeios was weaker than that of Naren, but stronger than that of Tot.
